enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Stretch arms. Bend knees. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands and face. Apply soap and rinse face. Dry face. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Remove clothes and turn on shower. Adjust temperature and step in. Wash body and shampoo hair. Rinse body and hair. Turn off shower and step out. Dry body and hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling water in the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Fill kettle with water and plug in. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, and butter. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Place frying pan on induction cooker and turn on. Pour oil and eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Remove eggs to plate and toast from toaster. Butter toast. Pour boiled water into cup and add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Clear and rinse dishes and place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Stretching and reading news on phone about the public transport strike affecting commuting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Read article about transport strike. Place phone on sofa. Stand up. Raise arms overhead. Bend forward. Stretch legs. Twist torso. Sit back on sofa. Pick up phone. Continue reading. Place phone down. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the computer at the desk and reviewing the day's program schedule, deciding to work from home because of the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom and sit at desk. Open laptop and press power button. Wait for boot and log in. Open calendar and program schedule. Scroll through schedule. Open email and read. Reply to email. Open messaging app and send message. Close laptop. Stand up and walk to kitchen. Fill kettle and boil water. Make tea. Walk back to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Continue reviewing schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: answering emails, drafting community program plans and joining online coordination calls with nonprofit partners
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk and open laptop. Open email client and read email. Type and send reply. Open document and type program plan. Save document. Open video conferencing app and join call. Speak on call. Mute and unmute microphone. Take notes. End call. Open spreadsheet and update budget. Save spreadsheet. Open email and reply to volunteer. Send email. Stand up and walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back and sit down. Continue working.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch, making a hot drink
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen and open refrigerator. Take out ingredients and place on counter. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker and place pan. Pour oil and add vegetables. Stir and add seasoning. Turn off cooker and transfer food to plate. Sit at table and eat lunch. Drink water. Clear and rinse dishes and place in dishwasher. Fill kettle and boil water. Make tea. Sit and drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, watching TV and resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Lie down on sofa. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Open eyes. Sit up. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: updating program budgets, scheduling community events and following up with volunteers online
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk and open laptop. Open spreadsheet and update budget numbers. Save spreadsheet. Open calendar and schedule event. Send invites. Open email and reply to volunteer. Send email. Open messaging app and message volunteer. Make phone call and speak. Hang up. Open document and write report. Save document. Stand up and stretch. Sit down and continue working.

enriched_activities.activity: Making tea and having a light afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle. Boil water. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in cup. Pour hot water. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Place snack on plate. Sit at table. Drink tea. Eat snack. Clear cup. Rinse cup. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing light household chores, vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Pull vacuum back. Move furniture. Vacuum under furniture. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away. Close closet. Wipe hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen and open refrigerator. Take out ingredients and wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker and place pot. Add oil and vegetables. Stir and add meat. Stir and add seasoning. Cover pot and simmer. Turn off cooker and transfer food to plate. Sit at table and eat dinner. Drink water. Clear and rinse dishes and place in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select movie. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lie down on sofa. Put feet up. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching. Sit up. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing personal care routines
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom and turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet and flush. Wash hands and brush teeth. Floss. Remove clothes. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body and apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply body wash and rinse body. Turn off shower and step out. Pick up towel and dry body and hair. Apply lotion. Put on pajamas. Turn off light and walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down time: reading and browsing phone with the desk lamp on, using the fan for comfort
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Turn on fan. Lie down. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow.

Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Stretch arms. Bend knees. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side.
